rooms.name: Deluxe Twin Room
rooms.description: For those who refuse to compromise on luxury, even for a fleeting stay, we welcome you to our exquisite twin-bedded rooms. Awaken to the gentle embrace of sunlight streaming through the windows, casting golden rays upon walls adorned with regal patterns. As you sip your morning coffee, let your eyes wander over the serene beauty from the balcony, where nature’s splendour gracefully complements the room’s majestic charm.

rooms.name: Deluxe King
rooms.description: Every corner of these rooms is a canvas of elegance, from the king size beds with headboards that echo the grandeur of Solanki arches to the vintage lamps that could easily grace the chambers of royalty. The rooms are thoughtfully equipped with a bathtub, perfect for unwinding, while a view of the pool—shimmering through the swaying palm trees—adds a touch of serenity.

rooms.name: Premium King
rooms.description: These rooms offer captivating views of the pool from the balcony, where the water mirrors the gentle sway of palm fronds, elevating your ‘us time’ with loved ones to new heights. Nestled on the first floor, these private sanctuaries exude the same regal elegance as the rest of our rooms, featuring a luxurious bathtub and the finest modern amenities, creating a haven of comfort and sophistication.

rooms.name: Executive Palace Suite
rooms.description: Designed for people who crave both comfort and elegance on their travels, our suites are your perfect escape! Located on the ground floor, these spacious suites boast a cosy living room and a plush bed that practically calls your name after a day of city escapades. Kick back with your favourite show on the sleek wall-mounted TV, or simply lose yourself in the view from your private balcony. As the cherry on top, each suite includes a powder room, offering the perfect final touches as you prepare to head back out into the vibrant city.

rooms.name: Premium Palace Suite
rooms.description: These suites in Mahabalipuram are the ultimate retreat for those seeking rest, relaxation, or simply basking in the sun’s golden glow as it dances off the pool. With modern amenities such as a luxurious bathtub, a 49-inch television, a private balcony, and a spacious living room, every detail is designed for your utmost comfort. Perched on the first floor, these suites provide privacy, ensuring your moments are uninterrupted, letting you savour every second of your time in peaceful solitude.

rooms.name: Executive Villa (Ground Floor)
rooms.description: Staying true to their name, these villas are the epitome of luxury, offering much more than a mere place to rest. A seamless blend of a gracious living room, a spacious bedroom, and a private balcony that frames awe-inspiring views of the Bay of Bengal, these villas promise an experience of unparalleled indulgence. Choose between the first or ground-floor villas, each thoughtfully designed with a powder room and a Jacuzzi—exquisite final touches that elevates your stay to new heights of luxury.

rooms.name: Executive Villa (First Floor)
rooms.description: Each morning in these villas, the first rays of sunlight dance on the garden, visible from your private balcony. Inside, a seamless flow of the living room and spacious bedroom invites relaxation, while modern amenities cater to your every need. Thoughtful touches like a powder room and Jacuzzi elevate the experience, ensuring your stay is nothing short of extraordinary.

rooms.name: Luxury Villa
rooms.description: We present two magnificent villas in this category: the Yuvaraaj Villa, adorned with opulent golden accents, and the Yuvaraani Villa, elegantly graced with silver tones. Both open into our grand wedding lawn, featuring a sweeping staircase that becomes a breathtaking aisle, creating a setting for moments destined to be cherished forever. Inside the villa, you'll find a spacious living area and three beautifully designed bedrooms illuminated by elegant chandeliers. Each villa also features a private pool for leisurely moments and a dedicated butler to cater to your every need. The regal decor and Rajputana-inspired furnishings exude majestic grandeur, providing a truly royal retreat. From the balcony, guests are treated to the captivating views of the Bay of Bengal’s gentle waves.

dining.name: Dhani — All-day Dining
dining.description: An exquisite restaurant in Mahabalipuram, where flavours from around the globe come together with the charm of local delights. It offers both à la carte and buffet options, complete with live cooking counters where you can personalise your favourite dishes.
details: Breakfast: 7:00 a.m. - 10:30 a.m. Lunch: 1:00 p.m. - 3:30 p.m. Dinner: 7:00 p.m. - 11:00 p.m. Rates: ₹1,000 - ₹3,000 Cuisine: Global Type of Service: Buffet and À La Carte Offers: Live Cooking Counters

Each plate at our all-day dining restaurant in Mahabalipuram is a culinary journey, blending flavours sourced from around the world with the essence of local inspirations. The menu offers a variety of options, from spicy Indian delights to flavourful Asian dishes and more, all expertly curated by Chef Venkatesh Bhat. Guests can choose between ordering from the à la carte menu or indulging in our lavish buffet spread. Adding depth to the vibrant dishes is our selection of premium drinks, enhancing every bite with richness and flavour.

The ambience offers a regal touch, with artisanal globe pendant lights casting a warm glow over unaltered flower-patterned chairs, making every meal unforgettable. For those seeking an outdoor dining experience, we provide an alfresco option that overlooks the palace and embraces the gentle caress of the winds.

dining.name: Somapuraa — Bar
dining.description: From its exquisite selection of beverages—featuring fine wines, scotch, whisky, and brandy—to signature cocktails served daily, this bar provides the perfect retreat for those seeking relaxation and unwinding in the city.
details: Timings: 11:00 a.m. - 11:00 p.m. Rates: ₹1,000 - ₹3,000 Cuisine: Light Meals and Finger Food Type of Service: Mocktail and Beverage from the Bar

Weary souls seeking solace after a bustling day in the city, we welcome you to our rustic yet sophisticated bar, Somapuraa. Here, a curated selection of wine, scotch, whisky, brandy, and beer awaits, offering something to delight every palate. Let the signature cocktails, meticulously crafted by our expert mixologist, enchant you—each sip a masterpiece that tempts you to indulge in seconds. Paired with delectable dishes from our à la carte menu, our resto bar in Mahabalipuram offers the perfect harmony of fine food and exquisite drinks, creating the ultimate retreat.

dining.name: Sagar Bar — Pool Bar
dining.description: Overlooking a stunning 144-metre pool, this bar serves a tempting array of crafted drinks, perfectly paired with gourmet light bites. Relax on comfy lounge beds, surrounded by lush greenery, making it a favourite spot for all who visit us.
details: Timings: 11:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m. Rates: ₹1,000 - ₹3,000 Cuisine: Grilled Food & Salads Types of Service: Light Meals & Finger Food, Mocktails & Beverages from the Bar ( À la carte) Offers: Drinks by the Pool

Overlooking India’s longest swimming pool, Sagar Bar is the ultimate spot to unwind and enjoy the good life! The 144-metre pool stretches out before you, perfect for a relaxing day of lounging on comfy beds, surrounded by lush greenery, with your drink in hand. Our bar in Mahabalipuram offers a tempting variety of crafted drinks, paired perfectly with gourmet light bites that elevate your dining experience to new heights. Whether you're soaking up the sun, taking a refreshing dip, or just chilling out, Sagar Bar is your go-to hangout in the city!

dining.name: Panch Mahal
dining.description: Behold! An ambrosial endeavor sewn together with the augustness of Indian heritage and the epic milieu of oceanic splendor. Embark on a gastronomical odyssey of epic proportions through five of India’s most fabled regal cuisines: the affluent plains of Punjab, the arid desert kingdoms of Rajasthan, the luxuriant Nawabi courts of Lucknow, the opulence of Hyderabad palaces, and the frigid poshness of Kashmir. The epitome of culinary excellence and impeccable hospitality. FIVE ROYAL CUISINES. ONE EXTRAORDINARY FEAST
details: PANCH MAHAL - A Glorious Culinary Voyage by the Sea (Soft Opening from 2nd October Onwards)
PANCH MAHAL - A Glorious Culinary Voyage by the Sea

Panch Mahal, the forthcoming jewel within our palace, is a poetic homage to India's royal kitchens, architectural grandeur, and the five elements of life—air, water, fire, earth, and space. Framed by Mahabalipuram's waves, it features gazebos that rise with the elegance of India's cultural legacy, floating serenely above still waters. As you settle in, surrounded by your loved ones, the gazebos glow under the soft embrace of candlelight, cast by majestic chandeliers. The night sky, adorned with stars, can be seen through the glass roof, adding a celestial touch to your meal. Meanwhile, the stage plays host to live classical music and cultural showcases, enriching the royal ambience. We are the best among restaurants in Mahabalipuram due to our cuisine. We draw inspiration from the royal kitchens of India's five princely states, each known for its distinct, royal fare:
Awadhi from Lucknow: Slow-cooked kebabs and aromatic biryanis
Punjabi: Rich gravies and tandoor specialities
Hyderabadi: Regal biryanis and spice-laden curries
Rajasthani: Bold, earthy flavours steeped in warrior heritage
Kashmiri: Saffron-infused dishes, dry fruits, and soul-soothing gravies

Every evening, you will be served royal thalis—a curated 7 to 10-course journey that transports you through the palaces and flavours of India's glorious past. Come, experience Panch Mahal, where luxury meets legacy, opulence mingles with nature, and you dine like royalty beneath the stars, by the sea.

articles.title: One-Day Luxury Stay Near Chennai with Private Beach Access at Kaldan Samudhra Palace
articles.summary: It's true. Sometimes all you need is a single day away from the...
paragraphs: It's true. Sometimes all you need is a single day away from the hustle and bustle of the city to bring your soul back to life. If you're searching for a luxurious escape near Chennai that combines royal elegance, beachfront serenity, and world-class hospitality, Kaldan Samudhra Palace in Mahabalipuram offers an experience unlike any other. Kaldan Samudhra Palace is located along the East Coast Road, just a short drive from Chennai. It is a destination where grandeur meets tranquillity. Inspired by the architectural splendour of historic palaces, the resort transports guests into a world of regal charm from the moment they arrive. The best part of the property is its access to the beach! Away from crowded public shorelines, guests can enjoy uninterrupted views of the Bay of Bengal, take peaceful morning walks, or do yoga by the beach or simply relax to the rhythm of the waves. The beach becomes an extension of the palace experience, offering privacy, serenity, and a sense of escape rarely found so close to the city.

Kaldan allows you to slow down while you walk through beautifully landscaped pathways, admire the majestic architecture, and soak in the atmosphere of a property designed to impress at every turn. The grand courtyards, intricate detailing, and palatial interiors create countless moments worth capturing, making the resort a favourite among couples, families, and photography enthusiasts alike.

The rooms at Kaldan are gorgeously set with luxury while taking nothing away from comfort. The rooms are spacious and the villas feature elegant décor, premium amenities, and serene views that complement the resort's royal theme. Whether you choose to spend your time relaxing indoors or exploring the property, every space is crafted to provide an elevated experience.

Dining is another highlight of a stay at Kaldan Samudhra Palace. You can relish a variety of culinary options ranging from traditional indian delicacies to international favourites at Dhani. The ambience reflects the grandeur of the property, transforming dining into a memorable occasion. The resort's restaurant ensure every palate is delighted. The Palace also gives you multiple options to let loose. Enjoy your afternoons by the stunning swimming pool- Sagar where you also have a poolside bar, or enjoy a rejuvenating spa treatment at Anthapuraa, or simply find a quiet corner overlooking the sea. The combination of luxurious surroundings and coastal tranquillity creates the perfect environment to recharge both body and mind.

Kaldan Samudhra Palace, with its vastness, is an ideal spot for a romantic setting. Couples looking to celebrate special moments can choose a romantic beachfront setting, picturesque architecture, and luxurious hospitality, making it a popular choice for anniversaries, proposals, and intimate celebrations. articles.title: 10 Exciting Activities To Plan Around Mahabalipuram Resorts
articles.summary: The Indian Eastern Coasts, towards the peninsular tip, lies the...
paragraphs: The Indian Eastern Coasts, towards the peninsular tip, lies the coastal town of Mahabalipuram, also known as Mamallapuram and is renowned for its rich history, stunning architecture, and beautiful beaches. As a popular travel destination, Mahabalipuram offers a myriad of activities that attract tourists from all over the world. Whether you are staying at one of the luxurious resorts or a cosy guesthouse, there is no shortage of exciting things to do. Here are ten activities that you should plan around the Mahabalipuram resorts to make the most of your visit.
Explore the Shore Temple

The Shore Temple is recognised by UNESCO as a World Heritage site and is one of the oldest stone temples in South India. A testament to the Dravidian culture, this temple was built in the 8th century during the reign of the Pallava dynasty. The temple is perched on the shores of the Bay of Bengal, offering a spectacular view of the ocean. Visiting the Shore Temple is like stepping back in time, and it’s a must-see for history enthusiasts and architecture lovers.
Visit the Pancha Rathas

The Pancha Rathas or the Five Rathas, are monolithic rock-cut structures that resemble chariots. Each ratha is intricately carved and named after the Pandavas from the Mahabharata. The UNESCO heritage showcase the architectural prowess of the Pallavas and provide insight into the historical and cultural significance of the era. Walking among these magnificent monuments is a surreal experience.
Discover Arjuna’s Penance

Arjuna’s Penance as it is more popularly known as, is a massive rock relief carved into the face of two adjacent boulders. It is also called The Descent of the Ganges. You can find intricate carving that depict various scenes from Hindu mythology, including the descent of the Ganges River to Earth and the penance of Arjuna. The sheer size and detail of this sculpture make it one of the most remarkable attractions in Mahabalipuram.
Relax on Mahabalipuram Beach

Mahabalipuram Beach provides a tranquil escape with its expanse of golden sands. It’s an ideal destination for those looking to escape the city’s chaos. Whether you wish to bask in the sun, enjoy a gentle walk, or participate in beach activities, this beach caters to all preferences. The calming sound of the waves and the pleasant sea breeze make the atmosphere all the more relaxing.
Surfing Lessons

For adventure seekers, Mahabalipuram offers excellent surfing opportunities. Several surfing schools provide lessons for beginners and advanced surfers. The waves along the coastline are perfect for surfing, and the warm water makes it an enjoyable experience year-round. Learning to surf in Mahabalipuram is not only thrilling but also a great way to connect with nature.
Visit the Crocodile Bank

The Madras Crocodile Bank Trust is home to a variety of crocodiles, alligators, and other reptiles. Founded by conservationist Romulus Whitaker, this centre promotes the conservation of amphibians and reptiles. Visitors can learn about their habits and habitats. It’s an educational and exciting activity for both adults and children.
Explore the Seashell Museum

The India Seashell Museum in Mahabalipuram is one of the largest seashell museums in Asia and showcases some of the most rare seashells from around the world. The museum also features exhibits on marine life and the history of shells. For those interested in marine biology or simply looking for an unusual attraction, the Seashell Museum is a must-visit.
Boating on Muttukadu Lake

Muttukadu Lake, located a short drive from Mahabalipuram, is a beautiful spot for boating and water sports. You have multiple activities in the lake including pedal boats, row boats, and motor boats. The breathtaking beauty of the lake makes for a peaceful and enjoyable outing. Water sports enthusiasts can also try windsurfing and kayaking.
Take a Cycling Tour

Cycling is a fantastic way to explore Mahabalipuram and its surroundings. Several guided cycling tours take visitors through scenic routes, historical landmarks, and local villages. Cycling allows you to experience the town at a pace that lets you appreciate the natural beauty and cultural heritage of the area. It’s an eco-friendly and healthy activity that can be enjoyed by people of all ages.
Enjoy Local Cuisine

There are numerous restaurants and eateries offering delicious dishes and Mahabalipuram is known for the best. From fresh fish curry to prawn masala, the flavours of Mahabalipuram are sure to tantalize your taste buds. Enjoying a meal at a beachfront restaurant while watching the sunset is a memorable experience.
Accommodation Options

Mahabalipuram offers a wide range of accommodation options, from luxurious resorts to budget-friendly guesthouses. Many resorts provide stunning views of the ocean, top-notch amenities, and easy access to major attractions. Whether you’re looking for a relaxing retreat or an adventure-filled stay, you’ll find the perfect place to rest and rejuvenate.

Among the top accommodations in Mahabalipuram is Kaldan Samudhra, a premier resort that offers a blend of luxury and tradition. With its magnificent architecture, world-class facilities, and breathtaking views of the Bay of Bengal, Kaldan Samudhra provides an unforgettable experience. The resort’s well-appointed rooms, exquisite dining options, and impeccable service ensure a comfortable and lavish stay. It’s an ideal spot for both leisure and business travellers, making it a standout choice in the heart of Mahabalipuram.

Mahabalipuram is a treasure trove of exciting activities and attractions that caters to people of all ages. Whether you are interested in history, adventure, relaxation, or culinary delights, this coastal town has something to offer. So, plan your visit to Mahabalipuram and explore these ten exciting activities for an unforgettable experience. Ready to make some memories in Mahabalipuram? Start planning your trip today!

articles.summary: Poised gracefully along the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of...
paragraphs: Poised gracefully along the Coromandel Coast of the Bay of Bengal, Mahabalipuram stands as a glorious ode to India’s cultural and architectural legacy. This temple town has metamorphosed into a regal retreat, extending an invitation to those yearning to immerse themselves in its spellbinding history.

Mamallapuram, also called Mahabalipuram, is linked to the story of a powerful demon king named Mahabali. The town’s name reflects its connection to both historical events, like the Pallava dynasty, and mythological tales, such as the legend of Mahabali. According to Hindu lore, Mahabali’s descent into the abyssal realms was precipitated by Lord Vishnu’s incarnation as the diminutive Brahmin, Vamana. Legend has it that King Narasimhavarman I, a luminary of the Pallava dynasty, orchestrated the construction of Mahabalipuram in the 7th century AD, etching this celestial episode in the sands of temporal antiquity.
The Shore Temple

Nestled upon the shores of the Bay of Bengal, the Shore Temple emerges as a paragon of allure in Mahabalipuram, adorned by a backdrop of unparalleled grandeur. Crafted by the Pallavas in the 7th century, this temple unfolds the tapestry of Dravidian architectural brilliance, with intricate carvings narrating sagas from Hindu mythology, such as the Ramayana and Mahabharata. It stands as an indomitable testament to the architectural virtuosity of the Pallava dynasty, beckoning discerning global sojourners.
The Five Rathas

The Five Rathas, colloquially hailed as the Pandava Rathas, stand as a symphony of architectural marvels in Mahabalipuram. Hewn from singular granite monoliths, these structures unveil the virtuosity of ancient Indian artisans, offering a panoramic view into the labyrinth of South Indian temple architecture. A homage to various deities and eponymously named after characters from the Mahabharata, the Five Rathas present an enthralling kaleidoscope of architectural styles, providing a lofty portal into the cultural mosaic of the region.
Arjuna’s Penance

Termed the “Descent of the Ganges,” Arjuna’s Penance transmogrified into an imposing bas-relief sculpture, an integral facet of the UNESCO World Heritage Site in Mahabalipuram. Immortalised onto the colossal boulders, this 7th-century masterpiece unfolds the visual narrative of the Mahabharata, encapsulating the sacred descent of the Ganges River. A magnum opus of ancient Indian rock-cut art, it stands as an eloquent testament to the artistic and cultural zenith of its epoch.
Krishna's Butter Ball

Enthroned in Mahabalipuram, Krishna’s Butter Ball assumes the mantle of a geological spectacle, captivating onlookers with its ethereal semblance. This gargantuan granite boulder, seemingly defying the laws of gravity, maintains its steadfast perch on an incline. A namesake homage to Lord Krishna and entwined with the Hindu mythos of his childhood butter pilferage, it symbolises not only a geological marvel but also an emblem of the town’s cultural scene.
The Varaha Temple

The Varaha temple is carved with meticulous finesse from a solitary monolithic rock and stands as the apotheosis of Pallava rock-cut architecture. This subterranean sanctuary from the 7th century venerates Lord Vishnu in his Varaha incarnation. Its walls bear witness to exquisitely detailed carvings, chronicling an intricate tapestry of deities and mythological vignettes.

paragraphs: Located just 60 km from Chennai, in the wonderful temple town of Mahabalipuram, directly opposite the Pancha Rathas, exists a wonder that houses a varied species of one of the most exotic kinds of nature’s beauty – seashells. Welcome to the India Seashell Museum, Asia’s largest and the world’s second-largest seashell museum.

India Seashell Museum originated as the brainchild of Mr Raja Mohammed, an avid seashell enthusiast. Soon, that idea grew into one of grandeur, with the current complex having over 7+ attractions and taking over 3-4 hours to visit.
The Start of a Fascinating Journey

As kids, we fondly remember going to the beach and collecting seashells. And that’s how it originated for the founder of the India Seashell Museum, Mr Raja Mohammed, who started collecting shells at the Pamban islands near Rameswaram in 1979. What began as a childhood hobby soon grew into a lifelong passion!

Mr Raja devoted over 40 years of his life to this unique idea, with the express intention of bringing his vision of an incredible museum for people to learn more about seashells and other such exotic creatures to fruition. With 100+ members and 40,000+ collections, India Seashell Museum is an enormous success, making Dr Raja’s dream a reality beyond imagination.
The Many Attractions to Visit
India Seashell Museum has a wide variety of attractions for people, not limited to just seashells! A day trip to the museum showcases the following:
India Seashell Museum

The Seashell Museum is a delight for people fascinated with shells, housing over 40,000 specimens of rare and unique seashells and minerals. The museum offers an exceptional perspective on conchology, with four galleries having several sculptures made entirely of seashells – including a train, a car and an aeroplane, and even houses the world’s largest seashell, the Australian Trumpet!
Mini Asia and Mineral Museum

The Mini Asia Museum is home to the unique rendition of the Singapore Merlion made completely of seashells. Adjacent to that is the Mineral Museum, a one-of-a-kind space for learning about all things mineral.
Mamalla Fish World

Indulge in a world of aquatic adventure in the Mamalla Fish World! The Fish Aquarium is one of the major attractions in the India Seashell Museum, with a wide collection of freshwater and marine fish. Also, enjoy a unique and soothing foot massage by the fish! Yes, there is a Fish Massage in Mamalla Fish World.
Pearl Museum

Welcome to Asia’s first Pearl Museum, home to a large collection of pearls acquired from different kinds of seashells. All our pearls are collected by Mr Raja, whose meticulous attention to their quality and colour makes this exhibit a wonderful spectacle!
Dinosaur Museum

Travel back millions of years with the Dinosaur Museum. These animatronic dinosaurs are a visual treat for those fascinated by these ancient creatures that lived about 110 million years ago! Get up close and personal with The Irritator, the short-armed T Rex, the toothy Velociraptor, and much more!

In addition to these attractions, the India Seashell Museum also has a 3D Art Gallery, a Horror Museum, a Virtual Gaming Arena and an exhilarating VR Experience! There’s also a gift shop selling authentic shell crafts and pearls for those who love collecting trinkets! The India Seashell Museum is open from 8 AM to 8 PM on all days of the week.

articles.title: On the Shores of Mahabalipuram
articles.summary: Mahabalipuram – a place known for its rich culture and...
paragraphs: Mahabalipuram – a place known for its rich culture and heritage. Almost 60 km from Chennai, this quaint temple town’s fascinating past is a thing of intrigue for many history buffs. Located along the Bay of Bengal, this UNESCO World Heritage Site attracts over 1.4 lakh tourists per year, beating the Taj Mahal as one of the top tourist destinations in India.
A Story of Immense Riches

With a legacy as fascinating as Mahabalipuram’s, its early history continues to be a mystery to many. With multiple theories floating around, we have never found concrete proof of what Mahabalipuram held before it became the stronghold of the Pallavas. The 7th century saw this town become a flourishing religious, cultural and art centre under the careful eye of Pallava king Narasimhavarma.

During the 7th & 8th centuries, numerous rock-cut architecture sprang up in Mahabalipuram, leading it to become a renowned UNESCO World Heritage Site. Out of these, the most famous monuments were the Descent of the Ganges or Arjuna’s Penance (one of the largest open-air rock reliefs in the world), the Pancha Rathas and, of course, the Shore Temple.
Standing Against the Test of Time

As the name suggests, the Shore Temple is an architectural marvel that stands tall on the shores of the Bay of Bengal, enticing people from all over the world to visit this marvellous structure due to its rich history and ornamental intricacy.

The sprawling temple has three shrines, one dedicated to the god Vishnu and the other two dedicated to Shiva. Each shrine is intricately carved with motifs and sculptures showcasing various deities, mythological scenes and stories from the Hindu scriptures, amongst other elements such as gateways, walls and superstructures constructed out of quarried stones and mortar.

The temple was built on the cusp of old and new-world technology, combining rock-cut and free-standing structural architecture. The temple complex’s foundation is a naturally occurring granite boulder, on which the structure is built by placing blocks of rock one above the other, much similar to modern-day construction.

Another interesting fact is that the Shore Temple was recorded to be a part of the Seven Pagodas, leading to the belief that there may have been six other structures that were washed away by the sea. This theory may hold some truth as the 2004 tsunami uncovered long-lost ruins, including a temple, stairs, a wall and other evidence, that may be a part of the Seven Pagodas, though there has been no concrete proof.

The Shore Temple has an immense religious, cultural and economic impact on society. There have been legends of sailors and merchants at sea using the majestic shikharas of the temple as a symbol to herald their arrival to the great city of Mahabalipuram. The Shore Temple’s significance in both the ancient and modern world is unparalleled, forever standing as an icon of the brilliance and magnificence of the great Pallava dynasty.
Sharing the Shores with a Symbol of Greatness

articles.title: Traditional Rajasthani Experience – Kaldan Samudhra’s Unique Claim to Fame
articles.summary: One of the fascinating things that stands out about India...
paragraphs: One of the fascinating things that stands out about India is the myriad cultures that inhabit this great country. No two states are the same, from the food that we eat to the languages that we speak. Our cultures and customs are wide and varied, ever-changing from state to state and sometimes even from city to city.

It can be difficult to travel a long distance to revel in the cultures of various places. Travelling isn’t for everyone, but that doesn’t have to restrict their desire to experience new things! And that’s where we come in.

North meets South in a breathtaking daze of Rajasthani culture infused with South Indian ambience. Welcome to Kaldan Samudhra, an Immortal Palace by the Sea. Set on the picturesque shores of the Bay of Bengal, 2 km from the temple town of Mahabalipuram, Kaldan Samudhra is India’s golden history come to life!

Inspired by the timeless architecture of Agra and Rajasthan, Kaldan Samudhra shines as a beacon of royal elegance in the modern world. It portrays a perfect slice of Rajasthani culture in the South, from the traditional welcome to the enjoyable entertainment.
A Royal Greeting

First impressions are important, and we stand by that! A Traditional Rajasthani Welcome awaits you as you enter our beautifully adorned lobby. Be greeted in a manner befitting Kings and Queens with the Rajasthani Nagada and Kachchhi Ghodi dance (a traditional dance where our performers dress as horses and dance to the rhythmic tunes of Nagada drums), traditional Aarti, Tikka, cold towels, Pagdi (Rajasthani Turban), and welcome drinks. As far as first impressions go, we certainly know how to make a splash and invite you in for a grand and welcoming time!
An Architectural Extravagance

As you cruise down the East Coast Road, the sight of our Immortal Palace by the Sea draws your gaze towards it with its Rajasthan-inspired carvings and motifs. Sculpted elephants, intricately ornate columns and arches greet you into a paradise that transports you to an era of unstinting luxury and majestic royalty.

Gilded ceilings and embellished carvings cover every corner of the property. Our rooms and suites embody the art of sculpted perfection. But the crowning glory of the Palace is our sea-facing villas, Yuvaraaj and Yuvaraani. This fantastical architectural marvel, with multiple bedrooms, separate living spaces and a private pool and jacuzzi, offers an experience unlike any other.
We bring you the symbol of royal love in a miniature form. The miniature Taj Mahal, standing high and mighty on a pedestal, is our ode to a time of bountiful riches and royalty.
Mesmerising You with Music & Dance

The Palace Hi-Tea is a traditional part of our everyday routine. Just before sunset, we gather our guests and serve them a traditional blend of masala chai, coffee or any beverage, paired with a delectable array of scrumptious finger food. The entertainment for the evening comes in the form of our Kalbelia dancers, whose traditional Rajasthani garb stands as a stark reminder of the beauty and heritage of Rajasthan’s rich culture.
Our graceful dancers sway to the dulcet tones of soulful Langa singers, as they belt out tune after tune of harmonious music that moves you. It’s a wondrous experience unlike any other!
Food for Thought

The way to the heart is through food. And at Kaldan, we are in the business of curating food that speaks to the depths of your soul. Though we dabble in all cuisines, our talented Rajasthani chef handcrafts a menu that exceeds every gourmet experience.

Enjoy Rajasthani cuisine in style – for the first time in Chennai. Authentic, rich and delectable, we offer you the best of Rajasthani meals, exquisitely prepared by our chefs to bring the heavenly flavours of Rajasthan to Chennai.
You Don't Have to Travel Very Far to go to Rajasthan

We bring Rajasthan to you! From extravagant and intricate architecture to heart-warming customs, decadent food with a medley of authentic Rajasthan flavours to traditional music and dance that transports you into the midst of Rajasthan’s rich culture, Kaldan Samudhra Palace is a one-of-a-kind venture that invites you to an immersive experience of all things Rajasthani in the heart of the South.

In a breathtaking fusion of Rajasthani culture and local ambience along the beautiful coasts of the Bay of Bengal, Kaldan Samudhra Palace is the place to be for someone looking to experience vibrant Rajasthani life only a drive away!
Book your stay today at Kaldan Samudhra Palace; timeless in its elegance, historic in its legacy.

paragraphs: Kaldan, which means an immortal place in Paradise, is your modern-day palace of dreams that offers more than just a place to stay. The resort boasts 106 rooms, suites, and villas, as well as the longest swimming pool (in Tamil Nadu), sprawling lawns, and a private beach.

You can expect to be pampered like royalty while enjoying curated experiences such as spa treatments, yoga classes, and meditation sessions. For your dining pleasure, Kaldan offers a global selection of cuisines, ranging from traditional Indian specialities to international delicacies.

At Kaldan, you can enjoy the best of both worlds – a luxurious stay with all the modern amenities, as well as the opportunity to explore the local area and experience the culture and traditions of Tamil Nadu.
Kaldan is the perfect place to nurture the royalty residing in every heart and aims to pamper that prince or princess within you with its luxurious amenities and experiences.

Despite the resort’s proximity to other upscale Beach View Resorts, Kaldan Samudhra has piqued the interests of many tourists and wedding planners. Over the past year, many guests booked their stay, and we are happy to share that they have added to our ever-growing count of highly satisfied customers. The location is picture perfect, the architecture is royal, the services are top class and the experience was amazing. A property’s ambience is important, but what truly matters are the unique elements that create a sense of exclusivity and enhance the overall experience for guests. The Rajasthani architecture in the midst of Chola architecture seemed like a refreshing thought, and our way of standing out. The design is not the only aspect inspired by the “Land of Maharajas”. The Kalbelia dancers are one of the cultural elements we have infused, whose sway to the mesmerising Traditional Rajasthani music beats and elegance transports you to the dunes of Jaisalmer. If that’s not enough, then we are determined to craft one-of-a-kind experiences – be it a romantic dinner or a milestone event.

The testimony to this is Kaldan Samudhra’s victory of being awarded the ‘Best Property for Outdoor Weddings’ at the 10th Exotic Wedding Planning Conference (EWPC) Apex Awards 2022 held in Bangalore in Sept 2022. The Apex Awards stand as the highest form of recognition for international excellence in the Indian Wedding Industry. They are created to honor excellence and applaud exceptional achievements and contributions to the expansion of the Indian wedding sector.

Kaldan Samudhra is second to none for weddings, offering an exquisite setting for a wedding away from home. With its spectacular beach views, unique menus crafted by renowned chefs, and a 55,000 sq. Ft Lawn, Kaldan Samudhra guarantees an unforgettable experience for couples looking to exchange vows. The 10,800 sq. ft. Pillarless Grand Ballroom is ideal for hosting grand Indian and International weddings, creating a magical ambience for you and your partner. Boasting awe-inspiring beauty and world-class amenities, Kaldan Samudhra is the ideal place to make your one-of-a-kind day truly unforgettable.

Kaldan proudly reflects its commitment to delivering inspiring and memorable experiences to its guests through its range of exciting activities and events. In its very first year, from hosting teams for the Chess Olympiad 2022 to welcoming racers from the Indian Racing League to the special Cake Mixing event, Kaldan Resort has shown its dedication to creating a truly unique and memorable experience for its guests.

At the Chess Olympiad 2022, held between 27 July and 10 August, we were delighted to welcome teams from Finland, Germany, Montenegro, Iran, Hong Kong, Argentina, Portugal, and Kazakhstan. Seeing that 4 August fell within the same period, we seized the opportunity to celebrate World Chocolate Chip Cookie Day by getting the chess champs to bake Chennai’s largest cookie. With great alacrity, the guests from each of the eight countries gathered around the chef in the dining area, who then guided them through each step of the cookie-making process. Everyone was fully engaged and enthusiastic about the activity.

It was a truly extraordinary day when we had the privilege of hosting the racers of the Indian Racing League for a day of relaxation and celebration. From their arrival to their departure, we ensured it was a day they would never forget. Our guests were taken in by the rhythms of our traditional Kalbelia music and enjoyed the majestic beauty of the Sagar pool. To top it all off, we spoiled them with an array of tantalizing delicacies.

The Yuletide season at Kaldan had been eagerly anticipated for months, and when it finally arrived, it brought with it the much-awaited cake-mixing ceremony. Deliciously fragrant dry fruits, nuts, and spices were placed into a bubbling cauldron, to which bottles of wine, rum, and whisky were added. As the inviting aroma filled the air, our guests excitedly donned gloves and joined in the mixing, delighting in the sweet smells that were created.

Starting with a vision of creating a new level of luxury hospitality, the resort has implemented an array of creative and effective F&B marketing campaigns to increase its visibility and brand recognition. This year, we worked around the clock to bring you unparalleled culinary experiences – from the Biriyani Mela to the Tricolour Feast for Independence Day, from the Onam Sadhya to the Awadh Food Festival, from the Navaratri Thali to a Rajasthani food fest – ‘Ghoomar to Ghewar’. We hope that our guests enjoyed these one-of-a-kind culinary experiences!

Tamil Nadu has some of the most passionate connoisseurs of Biriyani, so it was only natural that we organised a Biriyani Mela at ‘Dhani’ – a luxurious gourmet haven that offers a unique fusion of global and Rajasthani flavours. While the Biriyani took people by storm in July, August was a season for tri-colour. The ‘Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav’ fervour that has gripped the nation was an absolute joy for us at Kaldan as we curated the Tri-colour feast for Independence Day that included Tri-colour salads and desserts.

Inspired by the saying, ‘Love thy neighbor’, we hosted the renowned Onam Sadhya on the occasion of Onam. Authentic Kerala delicacies were curated by our chefs which touched the hearts of our guests in September. Awadh a historic region in north-central India is renowned for its unique cuisine, architecture, and music. So we wanted our guests to taste the choicest dishes of the region; as rich as its history. At the Awadh Food Festival we served kebabs, kormas, biriyanis and more.

As magnificent and vibrant as the festival of Navaratri is, so too was our Navaratri Thali an invitation for it. We crafted the thali in a manner that it was a perfect indulgence even for those fasting. In keeping with the spirit of our resort, we hosted the grandest of food festivals – ‘Ghoomar to Ghewar’. This fest was an homage to the royal culinary heritage of Rajasthan and featured special dance performances, puppet shows, and arts & crafts.

All said and done, none of this would have been possible without the patronage received from our guests. Kaldan Samudhra is our ground to deliver an upscale version of our promise of ‘Service from Heart’. We had as much fun planning every moment as attending to our guests and catering to their needs. We only hope that the coming years are grander, higher in spirits, and bring back our guests for second, third, and many more visits. Every nook and corner, every crevice of Kaldan has stories etched into it; stories of love, happiness, friendship, adventure, discovery, exploration, and magical moments.

articles.title: International Yoga Day celebrations at Kaldan Samudhra
articles.summary: The 8th International Yoga day 21st June 2022 was a...
paragraphs: The 8th International Yoga Day, 21st June 2022, was a special day for us at Kaldan Samudhra – ECR Chennai. The Famous sunrise yoga at Kaldan Samudhra is offered complimentary for all our residents, but on this International Yoga Day, we had several participants join us for the special celebratory session. It was a truly refreshing morning with a relaxing yoga session facing the iconic sunrise by the Bay of Bengal and a scrumptious breakfast after.

The World Yoga Day falls on the 21st June, which is a very auspicious day worldwide as it is of special significance to several religions and ethic cultures. The International Day of the Celebration of the Solstice is also observed globally on the same day. The Summer Solstice is the shortest day of the year in the Southern Hemisphere and the longest day of the year in the Northern Hemisphere. There are a number of things that happen on the Summer Solstice. Firstly, the summer solstice sunrise at which the sun reaches its highest point in the sky during the day. Secondly, the summer solstice sunset where the sun sets at its lowest point in the sky during the day. Finally, there is a shift in Earth’s rotational axis, which means that Earth’s North Pole moves towards the sun for a few weeks during the Summer Solstice.

The participants enjoyed a revitalising yoga session conducted by our in-house award-winning yoga teacher and were offered Kaldan Samudhra special energy shots – a concoction of fresh vegetables, fruits & herbs fortified with vitamins & minerals. The participants were then offered a breakfast buffet with live counters serving up crispy dosas & South Indian delicacies as well as a wide selection of freshly baked bread, fruits and continental breakfast items.

articles.title: Unveiling the Majestic Charms of Chennai and Mahabalipuram
articles.summary: Kaldan is located at the perfect location where...
paragraphs: A Journey through Breathtaking Destinations

Kaldan is located at the perfect location where both Chennai and Mahabalipuram are easily accessible. They offer a treasure trove of captivating destinations that allure visitors with their rich cultural heritage, pristine beaches, and awe-inspiring architecture. Whether you are a history enthusiast or a beach lover, these two cities have something for everyone. Here are a few must-see spots in Chennai and Mahabalipuram, unveiling the true essence of these enchanting destinations.
Marina Beach:

Marina Beach is known as the second-longest urban beach in the world. This sandy shoreline of about 13 kilometres offers a tranquil escape from the city's hustle and bustle. Visitors can enjoy leisure walks, indulge in delicious street food, or simply soak in the breathtaking view of the Bay of Bengal.
Fort St. George:

A testament to Chennai's colonial past, Fort St. George is a historic gem that transports visitors back in time. Built in 1644, this well-preserved fort complex houses the Legislative Assembly and the Secretariat of Tamil Nadu. The Fort Museum showcases artifacts, weapons, and documents that unravel the city's history. Exploring the fort's architectural splendor, walking along its ramparts, and visiting the St. Mary's Church, the oldest Anglican church in India, are experiences that immerse you in the city's colonial heritage.
Kapaleeshwarar Temple:

No visit to Chennai is complete without visiting the magnificent Kapaleeshwarar Temple. This ancient temple stands as a masterpiece of Dravidian architecture showing admiration for the Hindu God: Lord Shiva. Intricately carved gopurams (towers) and vibrant sculptures adorn the temple premises. Immersing oneself in the cultural significance of this sacred place is a truly captivating experience!
Elliot's Beach:

Elliot's Beach offers a serene and picturesque escape from the city sounds. Located in the Besant Nagar neighborhood, this tranquil beach is less crowded than Marina, making it perfect for relaxation and quiet walks. The beach's scenic beauty, coupled with the nearby Ashtalakshmi Temple and the Karl Schmidt Memorial, provides a serene environment for unwinding and enjoying the cool sea breeze.
Mahabalipuram:
Shore Temple:

Venturing further from Chennai, we arrive in Mahabalipuram, a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its remarkable stone-carved monuments. The Shore Temple, standing tall by the Bay of Bengal, is a splendid example of Pallava architecture. This ancient temple complex, dating back to the 8th century, is dedicated to Lord Shiva and Lord Vishnu. Its breathtaking design, intricate carvings, and the mesmerizing view of the sea create an ethereal setting that leaves visitors in awe.
Pancha Rathas:

Mahabalipuram is home to the iconic Pancha Rathas, a group of monolithic rock-cut temples. Each ratha (chariot) represents a different deity from Hindu mythology. These intricately carved structures showcase the architectural brilliance of the Pallava dynasty. The unique charm lies in their distinctive shapes and ornate carvings, transporting visitors into an ancient world of myth and legend.
Krishna's Butter Ball:

An amazing natural wonder in Mahabalipuram is Krishna's Butter Ball. A massive boulder perched precariously on a slope. Its unique balance and defiance of gravity have made it a popular tourist attraction. Visitors marvel at the enormity of the rock and wonder at the forces of nature that keep it in place.
Mahabalipuram Beach:

Mahabalipuram Beach offers a tranquil retreat where visitors can relax and enjoy the stunning coastal scenery. With its golden sands, clear blue waters, and gentle waves, the beach beckons both nature enthusiasts and leisure seekers. The beach is also known for its numerous stone sculptures, adding an artistic touch to the natural beauty of the surroundings. Watching the sunrise or sunset, taking a leisurely stroll along the shore, or simply basking in the peaceful atmosphere are experiences that make Mahabalipuram Beach a true delight.

Chennai and Mahabalipuram, with their historical treasures, architectural marvels, and picturesque beaches, offer a mesmerizing journey through South India's cultural heritage. Exploring the vibrant city of Chennai and venturing to the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Mahabalipuram provide an immersive experience that leaves a lasting impression. So, plan your visit, embrace the allure of these enchanting destinations, and create cherished memories that will stay with you forever.

Education: Under the Sri Lakshmi Ammal Educational Trust, the Accord Group’s education arm—Bharath Institute of Higher Education and Research (BIHER)—has grown into a premier multi-stream university with over 10,000 students and six expansive campuses across Tamil Nadu and Puducherry. Its institutions include top-ranking medical, dental, engineering, nursing, physiotherapy, and law colleges like Sree Balaji Medical College & Hospital, JR Medical College, and SLIMS. Recognised as the ‘Best Multi-Stream Private University in India’ by ASSOCHAM, BIHER is known for quality education, research, and a commitment to societal upliftment.

Hospitality: The Accord Hotels & Resorts and Kaldan Samudhra Palace bring together luxury, authentic South Indian hospitality, and world-class service across key destinations like Chennai, Ooty, Mahabalipuram, and Pondicherry. With a focus on personalised guest experiences and initiatives like the JUJU Guest Experience Ambassador program, the Group ensures every stay is memorable, warm, and indulgent.

Health Care: The Accord Group’s healthcare venture, Rela Hospital in Chennai, operated by JR Super Speciality Hospitals Pvt. Ltd., is a leading quaternary care centre founded in 2017 under the guidance of Dr. S. Jagathrakshakan and Prof. Mohamed Rela. Home to one of the world’s largest liver ICUs, the 450-bed facility is renowned for cutting-edge technology, global clinical expertise, and compassionate patient care.

Pharmaceutical Industry: Through NJK Pharma and Teyro Labs, the Accord Group is making a strong mark in pharmaceuticals, focusing on affordable, high-quality medicines and innovation. NJK Pharma is building a cGMP-compliant facility for WHO-standard formulations, while Teyro Labs specialises in oncology and complex drug manufacturing with USFDA and EUGMP-approved facilities, offering global R&D, CRO, and CMO services.

Brewery: Accord Distillers and Brewers operates a state-of-the-art 300 HL Automatic Brewery Unit with Meura and Ziemann technology, producing up to 1 million hectolitres annually, expandable to 1.5 million. With exclusive Carlsberg tie-ups, IMFL manufacturing, and a growing export footprint, the ₹500-crore unit is a major player in Tamil Nadu and beyond.

Minerals – Panyam Cement: Established in 1955, Panyam Cement became a household name for strength and quality, fueling major Indian infrastructure projects. After a revival led by Dr. Srinisha Jagathrakshakan and partners, Panyam is back in action, serving South India with renewed vigour.

Mining of Rare Earth: With deep expertise in beach mineral extraction, the Group specialises in ilmenite, rutile, and zircon, crucial for both everyday products and high-tech industries. Backed by international ties, they are gearing up to produce five to ten rare earth chemicals.

Power Generation: The Group powers forward with 300 MW of coal-based energy near Chennai, a 660x2 MW plant near Tuticorin, and a 1320 MW gas plant in Andhra Pradesh. Adding to the green grid, they’re setting up a 100 MW solar plant in Tamil Nadu.

Information Technology: The Group’s IT division operates two specialised companies. One delivers web-enabled ERP solutions, web hosting, and legacy system management for European clients. The other focuses on mobility solutions, big data analytics, and next-generation technologies. Together, they build scalable platforms, enhance digital ecosystems, and provide customised software development services to help businesses stay future-ready.

Engineering – CECL and Chiprime: From iconic landmarks to cutting-edge tech, CECL and Chiprime drive the Group’s engineering excellence. CECL, with its rich legacy since 1947, shapes India's skyline, while Chiprime leads in semiconductor innovation, gearing up for India's own fab facility.

Sports – Jagath Cricket Academy (JCA): Jagath Cricket Academy (JCA) in Pondicherry, a BCCI-approved facility, is dedicated to nurturing young cricket talent. With expert coaching in batting, bowling, and fielding, JCA prepares players for competitive cricket. The academy offers top-notch training grounds and fitness routines, helping players achieve peak performance.

Media – Accord Voice: Accord Voice is a prominent Tamil-language news platform under the Accord Group. Covering topics from sports and entertainment to politics and global events, it offers timely updates and in-depth analysis. With a focus on keeping its readers informed, Accord Voice continues to shape public discourse and provide valuable insights into current affairs.

policies.title: Booking Terms
paragraphs: You are making a booking with the hotel directly.
Please review the booking and cancellation policies for the bookings. In case you make a change or cancel the booking, the cancellation penalties specified may apply.
You may be asked to furnish the form of payment and identification proofs during check-in.
Other inclusions not listed as a part of this booking may be chargeable.

policies.title: Cancellation Rules
paragraphs: If cancellation is done 7 or more days prior to arrival, then the full amount will be refunded.
If cancellation is done between 5 - 7 days of arrival, then 50% of the booking amount will be charged.
If cancellation is done within 5 days of arrival, then the full amount will be charged.
In case of a no show, the full amount will be charged.

policies.title: Privacy Policy
paragraphs: This privacy policy sets out how we use and protect any information that the guest gives us when he uses this website.

We are committed to ensuring that the guest's privacy is protected. Should we ask the visitor/guest to provide certain information by which they can be identified when using this website, then the visitor/guest can be assured that it will only be used in accordance with this privacy strategy.

We at Kaldan Samudhra Palace are committed to the privacy of everyone who accesses our website kaldanhotels.com only collects personal data about the visitor/guest as needed to provide them with outstanding service, and to help process their request or provide them with information.

policies.title: Service from the Heart
paragraphs: We are committed to providing a safe, comfortable, and memorable experience for every guest. To ensure clarity and uniformity, we request you to review the following policies, which apply to all reservations and stays with us. The policies outlined are common across all our hotels. However, certain facilities or services may not be available at every property. In such cases, the respective policy will not be applicable. Guests are kindly requested to confirm the availability of specific facilities with the reception at the hotel or resort booked before making any assumptions. The hotel will not be held responsible for the same.

policies.title: 1. General Hotel Policies
paragraphs: Check-In & Check-Out: Check-in: 15:00 hrs | Check-out: 12:00 hrs (This may vary from property to property. Please check your confirmation for the correct time for the property you have booked.)
Early check-in / late check-out is subject to availability and additional charges.
Identification & Registration: Government-approved photo ID (Passport, Aadhaar, Driving Licence, OCI Card) is required at check-in.
Foreign nationals must present a valid passport and visa with stamping for us to report to FRRO.
As per RBI guidelines, PAN card details are mandatory for cash transactions above ₹50,000 in a single instance.
Cash payments above ₹1.99 lakhs are not permitted per PAN card in one financial year, whether in a single stay or across multiple stays.
Visitors: Visitors are allowed to the guest room at the discretion of the hotel till 2100 hrs. After that, guests must register with valid ID as an additional adult and pay the charges for the same.
Alternatively, they may use the lobby, lounge, and restaurants.

GST Compliance: GST number and company name verified at check-in; after departure or once the final bill is made, changes are not allowed as we upload all the information on the GST Portal and cannot be amended.
Children & Extra Guests: Maximum occupancy: 3 guests per room with one extra bed.
Children above 8 years are considered adults.
Extra adult/bed charges may vary depending on the hotel. (Please check with the hotel front desk.)
Pets: Pets are not permitted inside the hotel.
Smoking: All rooms are non-smoking. Designated smoking areas are available.
Smoking in non-smoking rooms or areas will incur a cleaning fee of ₹10,000.
Alcohol & Food: Alcohol consumption is only inside rooms, restaurants, and bars.
Outside food, hookah, or liquor in public spaces is prohibited.
Dress Code (Pool/Spa): Only appropriate swimwear is allowed in the swimming pool. Cotton clothes are not permitted.
Children must be accompanied by an adult.
Safety & Security: Baggage scanning and frisking may be conducted for security reasons.
Emergency exits and fire safety procedures are displayed in all guest rooms.
An electronic safe is provided in every room for valuables; the hotel is not responsible for loss of items.
Lost & Found: Lost items will be securely stored for 90 days. Unclaimed items will be disposed of responsibly.
Key Card Policy: Lost/missing cards will be charged (₹250 + taxes)
DND Rooms: For safety, rooms with continuous “Do Not Disturb” signage beyond 24 hours will be checked by the Duty Manager or an authorised person of the hotel.
Food Safety: Leftover food will be removed after 4 hours due to hygiene standards; outside food delivery is not permitted.
Allergy Disclaimer: The hotel is not liable for allergic reactions; guests must notify the F&B team of dietary restrictions.

Guest Responsibility for Damages: Guests are responsible for any damage to hotel property or loss of items caused by themselves, their companions, or their children. Charges may apply for repair or replacement.

Pest Advisory: While we maintain a comprehensive pest control programme, occasional sightings of insects or pests may occur due to the property’s gardens, water features, and natural surroundings. Guests are requested to keep windows and doors closed to minimise entry.

Right of Admission: The management of the hotel reserves the absolute right to grant or deny entry to the hotel premises and may request any guest to vacate their room or the property at any time, without providing a reason.

NOTE: If you have received any special approvals or deviations from our standard policies, please inform our Duty Manager upon arrival. This will allow us to verify and enable the approved arrangements for your stay.

policies.title: 2. Reservation & Guarantee Policies
paragraphs: All reservations must be guaranteed with a credit/debit card or advance payment
The hotel may reserve the right to pre-authorise cards before check-in
Non-guaranteed reservations are subject to release by 18:00 hrs on the day of arrival
Special requests (smoking/non-smoking, bed type, late arrival) are subject to availability and not guaranteed

policies.title: 3. Cancellation & No-Show Policy
paragraphs: 72+ hrs prior: No retention charges
48–72 hrs prior: 1-night retention
<24 hrs prior: 100% retention charge for the entire stay
No-Show: One night’s room charge plus taxes will apply unless cancellation was received 24 hrs before arrival.
For confirmed airport/railway pick-ups, non-arrival will incur transport charges in addition to no-show fees.
Refunds: If there are any refunds, these will be processed within 30 to 60 working days to the original mode of payment.

policies.title: 4. Arrival & Departure Policy
paragraphs: Early arrival: Before 09:00 hrs – full day; 09:00–12:00 hrs – 50% charge.
Late departure: 14:00–17:00 hrs – 50%; after 17:00 hrs – full day.
Guaranteed early/late check-in must be reserved in advance.

policies.title: 5. Payment & Billing Policy
paragraphs: Payment must be settled at check-out; no credit or cheques are accepted.

Invoices are sent via courier and email. Payments must be settled within the agreed credit period; 15% interest applies on overdue bills. (However, the company should already be a credit-listed company with the hotel.)
The cardholder and the physical credit card must be present, and PIN entry is mandatory while paying through a credit or debit card
Third-party credit card payments are accepted only with a signed authorisation form and a valid copy of the card, preferably only for corporate bookings.
Chargebacks: In case of disputes or chargebacks, the booking company/guest is liable to settle the outstanding dues
Data security: Payment card information is handled per PCI-DSS standards; any storage, transmission or processing of card data is through certified vendors.
Guests may use UPI apps linked to their bank accounts to settle bills
UPI payments are considered final at the time of transaction. Any failed or disputed payments must be resolved immediately at the Front Desk
Receipts will be issued for all successful UPI transactions, and the payment will be reflected in the guest account.
Guests may pay in cash up to a maximum limit of ₹1,99,999 per stay.
For any cash payment of ₹50,000 or above, submission of a PAN card is mandatory.
Cash payments must be made at the Front Desk. Receipts will be issued immediately upon settlement.
The hotel does not accept responsibility for cash lost, stolen, or misused after receipt unless negligence is established on the hotel’s part.
For corporate or group bookings, cash payments may require prior approval from the Accounts team.
Any combination of payment methods (UPI, credit/debit card, cash) is permitted, subject to compliance with RBI and GST regulations.

To ensure a smooth and comfortable stay, we request a refundable deposit (Kaldan Samudhra: INR 3,000) at the time of check-in for any incidental charges during your stay. This deposit can be paid via card, secure payment link, or hotel QR code and will be used to cover any additional services such as food & beverages, laundry, or other incidental expenses during your stay.

In case the deposit is not paid at check-in, a credit card pre-authorization for the applicable amount may be processed. If neither option is feasible for you, we will be having no options to post the charges in your room folio. We kindly request that all incidental expenses be settled directly at the respective outlets at the time of service.

Any unused balance from the deposit paid via card, bank transfer, or payment link will be refunded through bank transfer or cheque to the registered account. Kindly note that cash refunds are not available.

For credit card pre-authorizations, this is a temporary hold and not an actual charge. The held amount will be released by your bank after check-out, which may take up to 7 working days, depending on bank processing timelines.

policies.title: 6. Data Protection & Privacy
paragraphs: We collect personal data at check-in and through service touchpoints (vouchers, registration cards, feedback forms)
Data is used only for operational and promotional communication with guest consent
We comply with GDPR and Indian Data Protection Laws (IDPL). Guest information is never shared with unauthorised parties

policies.title: 7. Cancellation & No-Show Policy
paragraphs: Courteous behaviour towards staff and fellow guests is expected at all times.
Excessive noise, disorderly conduct, or unlawful activity may result in termination of stay without refund.
In-room dining trays should be kept outside, and Housekeeping informed for clearance.
“Do Not Disturb” signs will be respected; however, for safety, the hotel reserves the right to check after 24 hrs of no response.
Any damage, theft, or loss caused by the guest will be charged to their account.

policies.title: 8. Fire & Safety Policy
paragraphs: For your safety, please observe all fire and safety instructions displayed in the room. In an emergency, follow staff directions and proceed to the designated muster point.

The hotel maintains full compliance with local fire and safety laws and standards. Fire escapes, alarms, extinguishers, emergency lighting and signage are installed throughout the property. Interference with fire safety equipment is strictly prohibited.

Guest obligations: Guests must follow evacuation instructions, avoid blocking fire doors, and not use personal candles, incense, or other open flames in guest rooms or public areas. E-cigarettes, hookahs and similar devices are prohibited in rooms and public spaces.

Alarm & evacuation: On hearing an alarm, guests must leave rooms immediately using the nearest safe exit (do NOT use lifts) and assemble at the designated muster point. Do not return until authorised.
Medical & emergency response: The hotel maintains trained first-aid responders and an AED on site. Staff will coordinate with local emergency services as needed.
Inspections & drills: Regular inspections and fire drills are carried out for staff, contractors, and suppliers must comply with on-site fire safety rules.
Reporting: Any safety concern or blocked fire escape must be reported immediately to the Front Desk / Duty Manager.

policies.title: 9. Sustainability & Environmental Policy
paragraphs: Towels and linens are replaced once every two days unless guests request a daily change. However, for every new arrival, all linen and towels will be replaced.
Plastic reduction and energy-saving initiatives are implemented across the property.
Guests are encouraged to support sustainable practices during their stay.

Conservation measures: Low-flow fixtures, sensor taps where applicable, and efficient laundry cycles are used. Landscaping irrigation is scheduled to minimise evaporation (early morning/late evening). Greywater systems are used where permitted for landscaping.
We minimise single-use plastics and encourage locally sourced products to reduce environmental impact and support our community.
Please help us keep our hotel sustainable by using designated bins for organic, recyclable, and hazardous waste.

policies.title: 10. Kids Club, Children & Family Policy
paragraphs: Children are welcome. Children under 12 must be supervised by a parent/guardian in all public spaces and are only allowed in the Kids Club under supervised programme rules

Age & supervision: The Kids Club accepts children aged 3–12 when registered and supervised by our qualified staff. Children under 3 may be admitted with a parent/guardian present. Parents remain responsible for their children’s safety at all times outside supervised programmes.

Registration & waiver: All children must be registered by the parent or guardian, and a signed consent/medical waiver completed before use. The hotel will request emergency contact details and any allergies/medical conditions.
Operating hours & capacity: Pre-booking is recommended; capacity limits apply for safety.
Staff & safety: Staff are police-verified and background verification completed, first-aid certified, and trained in child safeguarding. CCTV may be used in common areas (not in changing rooms).

Liability & behaviour: The hotel will not be held responsible for accidents resulting from breach of supervision; misbehaving children may be asked to leave supervised activities. Parent/guardian will be notified immediately of any injury or incident.

policies.title: 11. Pool, Lawn, Gym, Beach & Outdoor Facilities Policy
paragraphs: Pool water is carefully monitored and chemically balanced at regular intervals by trained staff to ensure a safe and clean swimming environment
Guests are requested to shower before entering the pool to help maintain water quality and hygiene
Glass containers are strictly prohibited in the pool area for your safety
Children must be accompanied and supervised by an adult at all times while using the pool
Swimwear mandatory: Only appropriate swimwear is allowed in the swimming pool. Cotton clothes are not permitted
Pool safety: The pool deck and surrounding areas may become slippery when wet. Please walk carefully, supervise children at all times, and follow posted safety instructions to avoid accidents
For beach access, guests must heed tide and safety notices; the hotel will post advisories for unsafe sea conditions

policies.title: 12. Fine Dining, Bar & Restaurant Policies
paragraphs: Reservations & cancellations: Reservations are held for 15 minutes after booking time unless otherwise agreed. Cancellation charges may apply for large bookings.
Dress code: Smart casual or resort evening attire as specified for signature restaurants. Management reserves the right to refuse service for unsuitable attire.
Minors & alcohol: Alcoholic beverages will not be served to persons under the legal drinking age. ID may be requested.

Outside food & dietaries: Outside food is prohibited. Guests with allergies should inform staff; the hotel will make reasonable efforts to accommodate dietary needs but accepts no liability for allergic reactions.
Live entertainment/photography: Professional live performances or filming require prior authorisation and adherence to noise regulations and performance agreements.

policies.title: 13. Wi-Fi & IT Acceptable Use Policy
paragraphs: Access: Complimentary Wi-Fi is provided with fair-use limits. Higher bandwidth or dedicated connections are available for a charge.
Acceptable use: No illegal downloads, hacking, distribution of copyrighted material or accessing offensive content. Violation may result in suspension and referral to authorities
Security & liability: The hotel cannot guarantee the confidentiality of data transmitted over public Wi-Fi. Guests should use VPNs for sensitive transactions. The hotel is not liable for loss of data
GDPR & privacy: The hotel logs connection times and device MAC addresses for security; personal data handling follows the hotel’s Privacy Policy.
Wi-Fi is provided for personal use only.
The hotel is not responsible for interruptions, speed fluctuations, or incompatibility with guest devices
Any misuse of the internet (illegal downloads, offensive content, or criminal activity) will result in termination of access and may lead to legal action.

policies.title: 14. Photography, Videography & Promotional Media Consent
paragraphs: Public areas: The hotel periodically conducts photography and videography in public areas for marketing and promotional purposes. By occupying or using public spaces, you grant the hotel the right to use images and footage containing you for promotional use unless you notify the Front Desk at check-in to opt out.

Opt-out & privacy: Guests who wish to opt out should inform the Front Desk, and the hotel will make reasonable efforts to exclude them from staged shoots. For professional shoots, prior written consent and release forms will be obtained.
Commercial shoots: Any guest wishing to conduct commercial photography or filming must obtain written permission, pay applicable fees, and follow hotel guidelines.
Professional photoshoots, commercial filming, or drone use require prior written approval from hotel management.
Guests are welcome to capture personal memories, but are requested not to disturb other guests’ privacy.

policies.title: 15. Representation & Marketing Disclaimer (Marketing & Website Content)
paragraphs: Photographs, videos, menus, descriptions, and virtual tours on our website, social media, or third-party sites are for illustrative purposes only
The hotel reserves the right to modify room décor, amenities, and services without prior notice.
Guests cannot claim compensation based on a variation between the representation and the actual product.

policies.title: 16. Parking & Vehicle Liability
paragraphs: Parking facilities are available for guests
Parking is strictly at the owner’s risk. The hotel does not accept responsibility for loss, theft, or damage to vehicles or belongings left inside

Parking facilities may be provided on an as-is basis. Vehicles and contents are left at the owner’s risk. The hotel recommends that valuables be stored in the in-room safe. Security patrols are in place, but the hotel does not accept liability for theft, damage, or loss unless due to documented negligence.

policies.title: 17. Force Majeure & Jurisdiction
paragraphs: The hotel shall not be held responsible for failure to perform obligations due to circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to natural disasters, government restrictions, strikes, or technical failures
The hotel is not responsible for events caused by acts of God, industrial action, government action, pandemics, or other events beyond its reasonable control.
All disputes will be resolved under the laws of India, with Chennai courts having exclusive jurisdiction.

policies.title: 18. Safety & Liability Policy
paragraphs: The use of hotel facilities (pool, gym, spa, kids’ play area) is at the guest’s own risk
Children must be supervised at all times.
The hotel will not be responsible for injuries or accidents resulting from guest negligence.

policies.title: 19. Anti-Harassment & Zero Tolerance Policy
paragraphs: The hotel maintains a zero-tolerance stance against harassment of staff or guests
Any form of misconduct may result in immediate eviction and involvement of law enforcement

policies.title: 20. Health & Medical Support
paragraphs: An on-call doctor is available through the Front Desk. Charges may apply for consultations or treatment
First aid kits are available at the Reception, Restaurants, Spa, and other common areas

In case of guest illness or a medical emergency, our staff will provide immediate assistance and coordinate with medical professionals or emergency services as required. The hotel is not liable for outcomes of medical treatment provided by external doctors or hospitals

policies.title: 21. Accessibility Policy
paragraphs: The hotel provides wheelchair access, ramps, lifts, and accessible rooms (subject to availability).
Our staff will provide reasonable support services to differently abled guests, including assistance with mobility and luggage where required.
Guests are requested to notify the hotel in advance of any special requirements so appropriate arrangements can be made.

policies.title: 22. Transportation & Airport Transfers
paragraphs: Chauffeur-driven cars, airport transfers, and hotel-arranged taxis are available on request and subject to availability
Services may be provided by the hotel fleet or authorised third-party transport partners
The hotel is not liable for delays, accidents, or incidents arising from outsourced transportation services

policies.title: 23. Lost Baggage & Luggage Storage
paragraphs: A Left Luggage facility is available for short-term storage at the hotel. Guests must obtain a storage receipt from the Front Desk.

The hotel will take reasonable care of stored items; however, liability is limited, and the hotel is not responsible for loss, theft, or damage to baggage or personal belongings. Guests are advised not leave valuables in storage.

policies.title: 24. Spa & Wellness Policy
paragraphs: The minimum age for spa treatments is 16 years. Parental consent is required for guests below 18 years old
Appointments must be cancelled at least 4 hours in advance to avoid cancellation or no-show charges.

Spa treatments are provided by qualified therapists. However, the hotel is not responsible for any adverse medical conditions that may arise, and guests are advised to inform staff of any health concerns prior to treatment.
All guests are required to complete a self-information form prior to commencing any spa treatment, declaring any health conditions, allergies, or medical concerns that may affect the treatment.
The spa operates strictly as a professional wellness facility and does not provide any services other than professional therapies listed on the spa menu

The management maintains a zero-tolerance policy for inappropriate behaviour or misconduct towards spa therapists. Any violation will result in immediate termination of the service and may lead to further action as deemed necessary by the management
The spa and its staff shall not be held responsible for any complications arising from undisclosed health conditions

policies.title: 25. Emergency Situations (Specific to Coastal/Resort Hotels like Kaldan)
paragraphs: The hotel has protocols in place for natural disasters such as cyclones, floods, or earthquakes
In case of emergency, guests must follow instructions provided by hotel staff
Designated assembly points are marked within the property and will be communicated to guests during such situations
The hotel will coordinate with local authorities and emergency services to ensure guest safety

policies.title: Service Charge Policy
paragraphs: We are committed to delivering 100% guest satisfaction. A discretionary 5% service charge is applicable on room rent, food & beverage, and other services provided. Guests who do not wish to pay the service charge may opt out by informing the Front Desk before billing.
